body.statement: For fixed \(0<\epsilon<1/2\) and any sequence \(d_n\ge2\), \(\sup_{n\ge1}nR_{n,d_n,\epsilon}<\infty\) if and only if \(\sup_{n\ge1}d_n<\infty\).
body.justification: This exact boundary is available even though the sparse minimax rate is not yet known.
body.gap: Existing population-of-parameters rates index fixed entities and trials; they do not characterize root-risk behavior under growing observational categories.
body.consumer: The result tells practitioners when ordinary parametric precision for the whole CATE law is mathematically impossible.
